unmapped_localities: Western Indo-Pacific | Saudi Arabia | Rabigh Lagoon
process_score: Equal-weight mean of selected KO coordinates in full Shell CLR, z-standardized across 191 profiles using sample SD
process_R2: Univariate between-realm SS divided by total process-score SS; no process-level significance test
conditional_R2: Unique realm SS after log10 total KO counts divided by total process-score SS; not df-adjusted
map_estimator: RMS Aitchison distance from locality mean CLR to equally weighted centroid of all 26 localities
map_coordinates: Median of complete profile coordinate pairs within each named locality; no invented coordinates or jitter
bootstrap_role: Within-locality profile resampling and recomputation of global centroid; uncertainty only; point estimate uses all profiles
